title: UC San Diego Resting State EEG Data from Patients with Parkinson's Disease
description: This dataset comprises resting-state electroencephalography (EEG) recordings collected from patients with Parkinson's disease and healthy controls at the University of San Diego. The study includes 31 participants with EEG data acquired using BioSemi systems, with Parkinson's patients recorded in both on- and off-medication states. The dataset supports investigation of cortical oscillatory dynamics and neurophysiological markers associated with Parkinson's disease and dopaminergic therapy effects.
methods_description: Resting-state EEG recordings were acquired using BioSemi systems. Healthy control participants completed a single session, while Parkinson's disease patients underwent two sessions: one on dopaminergic medication and one off medication. UPDRS rating scales were collected by laboratory personnel who completed online training (not board-certified neurologists). Recordings include 46 EEG files with scalp electrode montages and trigger codes from the BioSemi Status channel.
